title: Actual integral scalar telescope in section modules
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be any scheme. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ pull back the actual continuous condensed rings $\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ and $\underline E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Let $a:R\to S$ be the reconstructed section-ring map of the actual inclusion, and fix any normalized scalar-derived pair $F\dashv U$ for $a$ [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], on the ordinary unbounded module-sheaf derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then multiplication by $\ell$ is invertible on every object of $D(S)$, $U$ is full, and for every complex $P$ of $R$-module sheaves there is an isomorphism $\beta_P:Q(\operatorname{colim}(P\xrightarrow{\ell}P\xrightarrow{\ell}\cdots))\simeq UF(QP)$ satisfying $Q(\iota_{P,0})\beta_P=\eta_{QP}$, where $\eta$ is the specified adjunction unit. The colimit is the ordinary termwise sheaf-module colimit. There is no boundedness, constructibility or completeness hypothesis on $P$.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2, Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14(2); agent extraction of the coefficient and exact-equivalence transport.

proof.text: The continuous coefficient extension unit is the repeated-ell telescope degreewise. Exactness computes its ordinary derived extension on every complex. The exact derived-unit comparison identifies the image of the termwise unit with the specified mixed derived adjunction unit. Compose the two normalized isomorphisms.

The invertible ordinary counit gives full and faithful restriction. The exact left adjoint implies restriction preserves K-injective complexes, hence the right-derived restriction is fully faithful. Invertibility of multiplication by ell on rational derived modules transports across the section equivalence; use the proved derived_nsmul_isIso helper in the continuous-constructible-integral-image module.

Transport the actual restriction through the section-module equivalences. The mate of the right square is an isomorphism and its unit equation transfers the normalized complex telescope to any specified scalar-derived adjunction.

theorem integralSectionScalarTelescope
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (X : Scheme.{u})
    [(Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (s : ScalarDerivedPair.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (padicIntegersToPadicSubfield.{u} X l E))) :
    let a := sectionScalarMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (padicIntegersToPadicSubfield.{u} X l E)
    (∀ T : DerivedCategory (scalarModules.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (ModuleObjectRingedComparison.ring (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E.1) X)),
      IsIso (l • 𝟙 T)) ∧
    (scalarDerivedRestriction.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1} a).Full ∧
    ∃ β : ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarModules.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (ModuleObjectRingedComparison.ring (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj l E.1) X)) ℤ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (colimit (Functor.ofSequence (fun _ : ℕ ↦ l • 𝟙 P))) ≅
        (scalarDerivedRestriction a).obj (s.derived.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)),
      ∀ P, DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (colimit.ι (Functor.ofSequence (fun _ : ℕ ↦ l • 𝟙 P)) 0) ≫ (β P).hom =
        s.adjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
